race.comment: APPEARED (1) making his Australian debut for the Bjorn Baker yard and gelded over the break. At his third race start he outstayed them to get the job done over 2414m at Curragh ten months ago. Fitted with the two trials and can make a winning debut from the good gate. SIR TUA (4) stretches out to this trip for the first time and a win looks imminent. Returned good closing splits from back in the field with a slashing second over 1600m at Goulburn. Will go back again from the gate and launch late. TACITLY (5) improving gelding with his hoof on the till. Ran on late again with a solid second over 1600m at Scone. This looks well within his grasp if he can get cover from the sticky draw. VONDEL (10) deep into the prep and strips fitter for this. Just under six-weeks between runs with a tidy fifth over 1630m at Wyong. Senior rider hops on and she looks to have genuine claims. The chances don't end there.
